g.text: How execution evolved before and after separating the controller
Paired diagnostic: same 27 graphs × 30 counts per model; opened panel, not confirmation.
Historical models differ in memory, objectives, data and capacity. Isolated arms share an identical executor.
Historical Steps changes can alter the trajectory; each count is executed separately. Isolated R ignores Steps.
Measured sparse counts only; no interpolation. Correct final letters can recur on cycles despite earlier errors.
